assertion_results.text: The plan determines feature-branch workflow mode (not direct-to-main) based on the atomicity constraints in the feature description

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: Feature TC-9005 has priority 'High' (not Undefined). impact-map.md documents: '"priority": {"name": "High"}' in the Additional Fields section, with explanation: 'Priority: "High" -- inherited from Feature TC-9005 (priority is set and not "Undefined", so propagated to all tasks)'. summary-comment.md states: 'Priority: High -- propagated from Feature TC-9005 to all created tasks'.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: Feature TC-9005 has fixVersions: ['RHTPA 2.0.0']. No fixVersion scope configured in CLAUDE.md Jira Field Defaults (absent, defaults to 'both'). impact-map.md documents: '"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 2.0.0"}]' with explanation: 'fixVersions: ["RHTPA 2.0.0"] -- inherited from Feature TC-9005; no `fixVersion scope` configured in Jira Field Defaults, defaulting to "both" (propagate to tasks)'. summary-comment.md states: 'fixVersions: RHTPA 2.0.0 -- propagated from Feature TC-9005 to all created tasks (no `fixVersion scope` configured in Jira Field Defaults; defaulting to "both", which includes task-level propagation)'.

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md exists in the outputs directory and contains an 'Inherited Field Values' section (lines 37-39) stating: 'Priority: High -- propagated from Feature TC-9005 to all created tasks' and 'fixVersions: RHTPA 2.0.0 -- propagated from Feature TC-9005 to all created tasks'. impact-map.md also contains an 'Additional Fields for Created Issues' section (lines 36-47) with the same information including JSON field values and inheritance rationale.
